kits.title: Standard 52-card playing deck
kits.summary: Opaque full-card face PNGs for poker / blackjack / Solitaire-style games using eve.Card(). Matches examples/cardgame (262×372 source, ~2:3).

window.notes: examples/cardgame default; LayoutConfig defaults are independent of window size.

layoutDefaults.notes: eve.card LayoutConfig defaults. Source art may be larger; keep the same aspect.

constraints: One complete printable card face per file (pip, rank, suit art included).
Do not leave a transparent hole in the card body; opaque or near-opaque face.
No UI chrome, drop shadows on the canvas, watermarks, or extra margins outside the card rectangle.
Keep rank/suit readable at displaySize 110×150.
Prefer a shared style across all 52 faces.
slots.promptTemplate: Create one stylized playing-card FACE as a single PNG. Exact pixel size {width}x{height} ({aspectRatio}). Suit={suit}, rank={rank}. Full card including corner indices and center pip art. Flat centered card, no table, no hands, no text beyond standard rank/suit marks, no watermark. Style: {style}.
slots.consumer: gfx.newTextureFromFile(path); cardData.setArt(texture). Layout uses LayoutConfig cardW/cardH.

constraints: Same outer rectangle as face slots.
Symmetric pattern readable when rotated 180 degrees.
No suit/rank marks that reveal the face.
slots.promptTemplate: Create one playing-card BACK PNG at {width}x{height} ({aspectRatio}). Decorative symmetric pattern, no rank or suit, no watermark, flat card only. Style: {style}.
slots.consumer: Used when Hand.setFaceDown(true); bind via setArt or project-owned draw path.

kits.title: Collectible / CCG card art
kits.summary: Illustrated card faces for Hearthstone / MTG / Slay-the-Spire style games. Engine default on-screen card is 110×150; source art is 512×724 (~2.5×3.5 trading-card proportion).

window.notes: Typical landscape HUD; hand sits near the bottom via LayoutConfig.handY.

layoutDefaults.notes: Match eve.card LayoutConfig defaults unless the project overrides setCardW/setCardH.

constraints: Full finished card: frame, title plate, cost gem, and illustration already composited.
Keep title/cost/stat text glyphs large enough to survive downscale to 110×150.
No table clutter, no hands holding the card, no drop-shadow outside the card silhouette.
Reserve the upper 55% for the illustration window if the project later splits art from frame.
slots.promptTemplate: Design one collectible game card FACE PNG at exact {width}x{height} pixels ({aspectRatio}). Card id={cardId}, name={name}, cost={cost}, kind={kind}. Include frame, title, cost gem and centered illustration. Style: {style}. No watermark, no table, single upright card.

constraints: Illustration only — no frame, cost gem, or title plate.
Subject fully inside the frame with clear silhouette.
Useful when the project draws a procedural frame over a separate art texture.
slots.promptTemplate: Create card ILLUSTRATION only, {width}x{height} ({aspectRatio}), subject={name}, mood={mood}. No frame, no UI, no text, no watermark. Style: {style}.
slots.consumer: Optional; project composites with a UI frame before setArt, or draws via capturePresentation().

constraints: Same outer size as face.
Faction/logo pattern only; no individual card identity.
slots.promptTemplate: Collectible card BACK at {width}x{height} ({aspectRatio}). Shared deck pattern, style: {style}. No text identifying a specific card.

kits.title: Visual-novel dialogue stage
kits.summary: Background plates plus transparent character portraits for eve.Dialogue() + eve.Avatar() image layers. Matches examples/dialogue (1024×1536 portraits displayed at 256×384; stage window 960×540).

window.notes: examples/dialogue default (16:9). Backgrounds may be authored at 1920×1080 and scaled.

constraints: Full-bleed environment plate; no letterboxing bars inside the image.
Keep the lower 28% relatively calm — dialogue box and portraits sit there.
No readable UI text, logos, or watermarks.
Characters belong in portrait slots, not painted into the background (unless intentionally baking a crowd).
slots.promptTemplate: Visual novel BACKGROUND plate, exact {width}x{height} (16:9). Scene={sceneId}, description={sceneDescription}. Empty of hero characters, soft depth, calm lower third for dialogue UI, cinematic lighting, no text, no watermark, no UI chrome.
slots.consumer: Project draws with gfx.drawImage / texture fullscreen behind avatar.render and dialogueView.render.

constraints: Waist-up portrait; full head, both shoulders and arms inside the frame.
True transparent alpha background — not a checkerboard or flat chroma key baked opaque.
No scenery, border, watermark, or name plate.
Silhouette isolated with clear margin (~8% edges).
Adult characters only for shipped examples; follow project content rules.
slots.promptTemplate: Generate a visual novel character cutout PNG at exact {width}x{height} (2:3). Character={characterId}: {characterDescription}. Waist-up, full head and both shoulders inside frame, relaxed arms, facing {facing}. Actual transparent background with alpha, no scenery, no text, no border, no watermark. Entire silhouette isolated with clear margin.
slots.consumer: avatar.newImageAvatar(); addLayer('portrait', texture, 0); setLayerSize('portrait', 256, 384); dialogue.bindAvatar(id, av); dialogue.show(id, 'left'|'center'|'right').

constraints: Same framing, scale, and body pose as the base portrait — only face/expression changes.
Register via Avatar.defineExpression / applyExpression or separate layers.
slots.promptTemplate: Same character cutout as base portrait for {characterId}, expression={expression}, exact {width}x{height} (2:3), identical body framing, transparent alpha, no scenery, no text.
slots.consumer: av.defineExpression(name, 'portrait=1') with per-expression textures, or layered ImageAvatar parts.
